items.title: Why General-Purpose LLMs Fall Short in Business
items.summary:
A general-purpose LLM can produce impressive answers, but real business problems demand domain knowledge, reliable outputs, and behavior tailored to a specific workflow.

In this Short, an author of Building Specialized AI Systems explains why off-the-shelf models are often only the starting point—and how specialization can turn a capable model into a useful business system.

Learn more about Building Specialized AI Systems: https://hubs.la/Q04tZN370
